items.title: Loop runner's `git add -A` commits transient runtime state into git history
items.description: The loop runner commits via `git add -A && git commit` (packages/loop/src/git-commit.ts), which sweeps its OWN runtime files into the per-item commit: .loop.lock (a lock file!), state.json, backlog.json.bak, and the DONE marker. Observed during the release-automation loop (commit 62190f2 contained .rauf/.loop.lock + state.json + backlog.json.bak). Lock/marker files must never enter history. Fix: gitignore the per-backlog .rauf/ runtime files (lock, state.json, *.bak, DONE, rauf.log) and/or scope the runner's staging to exclude its own state dir via pathspec. NOTE: the agent-self-commit half of this was already fixed live in .rauf/RAUF.md (commit 656d8c6); this item is the runner-side staging hygiene follow-up.
acceptanceCriteria: After a loop run, git log shows NO .loop.lock, state.json, *.bak, or DONE files in any [rauf] commit
Per-backlog .rauf/ runtime files are gitignored or excluded from the runner's git add via pathspec
backlog.json itself remains tracked and committed normally
Exactly one commit is produced per completed item (no duplicate agent+runner commits)
pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build pass
items.notes: Surfaced while dogfooding forge-5-loop on release-automation, 2026-06-10.

items.title: Single-gate review for loops — suppress per-iteration security/review hooks in child sessions
items.description: When a commit/Stop-triggered review hook (e.g. the security-guidance plugin) is installed globally, the loop's child agent sessions trigger it every iteration. With the agent self-commit removed (RAUF.md 656d8c6) the heavyweight commit-review no longer fires, but the Stop-hook diff review still runs per child session, and there is no first-class way to run a loop with per-iteration review hooks suppressed in favor of ONE review over the cumulative branch diff. For human-in-the-loop autonomous dev, per-item review inside autonomous child sessions is the wrong altitude (the agent rubber-stamps findings); review belongs at the gate, surfaced to the human. Add: a documented/opt-in way for the loop to spawn child sessions with per-iteration review hooks disabled (e.g. propagate ENABLE_CODE_SECURITY_REVIEW=0 or a generic hook-suppression env), plus a post-loop gate review over main..HEAD.
acceptanceCriteria: Loop provides a documented, opt-in flag/config to run child sessions without per-iteration review-hook noise
A single review over the cumulative branch diff (main..HEAD) is run or documented as the gate step after the loop
The mechanism is generic (not hardcoded to one plugin) and documented in docs/SPEC-* and rauf guidance
Default behavior is unchanged unless explicitly opted in
pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint pass
items.notes: Surfaced while dogfooding forge-5-loop on release-automation, 2026-06-10. The harness auto-mode classifier also blocks ad-hoc ENABLE_CODE_SECURITY_REVIEW=0 on the loop command, reinforcing the need for a first-class, intentional mechanism.

items.title: Loop autonomy: RAUF_NEEDS_HUMAN sets item aside and continues (no halt)
items.description: needs_human now sets the item aside (blocked + needsHuman flag) and the loop continues with other runnable items instead of halting; also restores the --review pass on that path. Implemented manually in commit 90cffe0.
acceptanceCriteria: needs_human item is stored blocked+needsHuman and not reselected
loop continues to other runnable items; dependents stay pending
review pass runs after a needs_human set-aside when items completed
pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint pass
items.notes: Dogfooding fix surfaced during forge-5-loop on release-automation, 2026-06-10.

items.title: test-sandbox verify.sh trips the loop dirty-tree guard (fixture drift + no --force)
items.description: Committed sandbox fixtures (test-sandbox/.rauf/backlog.json, specs/feature-a/backlog.json) still say 'ralph loop runner' while setup.sh regenerates them as 'rauf', so the tree is dirty after setup and the loop refuses to run. The sandbox harness also never passes --force despite the loop mutating tracked backlog fixtures during a run. Fix: regenerate+commit the fixtures (rename leftover) AND/OR have run.sh/verify.sh pass --force (the sandbox intentionally mutates fixtures). Surfaced while verifying the needs_human autonomy fix 2026-06-10.
acceptanceCriteria: bash test-sandbox/verify.sh passes from a clean checkout
committed sandbox fixtures match setup.sh output (no 'ralph' leftovers)
